column1: # FNA3D's OpenGL driver makes the GL calls of other threads on the main thread, once a frame in SwapBuffers; MARVEL Cosmic Invasion stopped before its first frame without the
# host's run of that list when the main thread waits (dm/host/fork_fna3d_pump.c). Here the same driver: SwapBuffers at main+0x1b0390, the list at renderer+0x578, under the
# lock at +0x580 (SwapBuffers takes and empties it at main+0x1b0510..0x1b0784; CreateTexture2D called from another thread appends to it at main+0x1b3810)
